plan.question: Does per-episode BG-derived deletion budget add utility when pixel ordering is held fixed?
plan.control: One fold-specific constant deletion fraction learned from other3 folds: sum originalBGgateK / sum eligibleD pixels. Exclude entire photograph-connected groups touching heldout fold. No GT in fraction.
plan.classification: Development-derived cross-fitted hyperparameter, not a new semantic signal and not independent confirmation.
plan.rounding: K_fixed=floor(fraction*episode_D_pixels+0.5); stable ascending row-major tie break. Domain and RCG ranking are identical to adaptive arm.
plan.prediction: No threshold grid or changes to previous method. All220 fixed-fraction masks sealed before this evaluation reads GT.
plan.data: Existing exposed DEV220, old120/new100 separately plus combined220; photo-group bootstrap2000 RandomState0.
plan.diagnostic: Post-hoc labels only: correlate adaptive fraction and adaptive-minus-crossfit fraction with full-D deletion IoU utility; also adaptive fraction versus FP fraction ofD. No diagnostic changes budget.
plan.cost: One CPU/BLAS/Torch thread; existing frozen fields/masks only.
